reassessment_reason: Current SOS guidance preserves the bounded interactive CSV route. DOR catalog metadata establishes that Business Lookup is an external href, not a downloadable Socrata table; public-record list constraints must accompany that alternative source evidence.

access.bulk: SOS advanced searches support CSV export but warn broad queries can overload, time out or error; no complete snapshot contract or numeric truncation limit is published. DOR Business Lookup catalog 4wur-kfnr is an external href with no columns, not a bulk dataset.
access.api: DOR metadata reports assetType/displayType/viewType href and columns: []; its sole data access point is an HTML lookup. No broad business-entity read API or supported unattended retrieval contract was established.
access.search: SOS corporation search requires no login and supports type/status/date filters and CSV exports. DOR lookup covers business licenses, excise-tax accounts and reseller permits; interactive access does not establish enumeration authority.

fields.summary: SOS documents business name, UBI, type, status, expiration and principal-office fields, but exact CSV headers, complete-result controls and stable-identifier lifecycle remain unpublished. DOR catalog has columns: [] and links a search tool rather than publishing a row schema. Exclude registered agents, governors, owners, officers and other natural-person fields.

active_status_semantics: SOS statuses describe filed documents, not proof of current business operation. DOR active-account metadata describes account/license scope, not proof of an open establishment. Existing L&I ACTIVE contractor status is separate sector-specific license evidence.
statewide_completeness: No safe complete SOS snapshot contract was established. DOR describes all active business-license accounts and five years of closed accounts, but publishes only an interactive lookup route. Existing L&I coverage is contractor-license scope and cannot fill the broad-organization gap.
address_zip: SOS principal-office street/mailing addresses are administrative evidence; exact export fields and address roles remain unresolved. DOR searchable address fields do not establish a bulk schema or verified physical sites. Exclude registered-agent and personal address roles.
automation_terms_fees: SOS search/CSV has no listed export fee and needs no login, but provides no supported automation/rate contract. DOR public-record guidance requires a noncommercial-purpose declaration for lists of licenses, individuals and/or taxpayers and warns against commercial-purpose list release. No request or declaration was submitted.
redistribution: DOR catalog labels the href Public Domain, but that metadata is not proof of an unrestricted bulk delivery route or resolution of the publisher's public-record list constraints. SOS commercial derived-use/redistribution rights remain unresolved. No broad-source redistribution or production admission is approved.
temporal_refresh: SOS inactive records older than ten years leave the online system and filings determine status; snapshot/change/deletion/replay/checksum controls are unpublished. DOR catalog advertises Daily posting and a 2021-2026 period; these are metadata statements, not an observed downloaded snapshot or API freshness guarantee.

citations.evidence: No-login search, advanced CSV export, broad-query warnings, filed-document statuses and ten-year inactive-record boundary.
Official DOR Business Lookup href metadata: empty columns, HTML access point, Public Domain label, Daily posting and active-account/five-year-closed scope.
State catalog guidance explicitly uses DOR Business Lookup as an example of an external link landing page.
Publisher commercial-purpose list constraints and Declaration of Non-Commercial Purpose requirement; no request submitted.
Tax account, reseller permit and general business-license lookups have distinct scope; not all businesses have a tax account.

strongest_next_action: Keep broad-source acquisition on hold and retain separate L&I sector coverage. Resolve complete person-free snapshot/schema, exact scope, identifier/status/address semantics, control totals, changes/replay, supported automation and applicable use rights before implementation. Do not partition interactive searches or treat href metadata as a data API. This assessment authorizes no contact, declaration, payment, account, terms acceptance, acquisition, network execution or pointer changes.
